# Stromboat — The Launch Dock (agent quick reference)

Collection: 1,333 generative pixel boats, ERC-721 on BNB Chain (chain id 56).
Site: https://stromboat.com/ · Docs: https://stromboat.com/docs.html · Machine-readable mint file: https://stromboat.com/mint.json
Contract: 0xC3CB4dF5256c8429Eab306E924BF6E3E6c72163d (BNB Chain). Deployed; mint is OPEN —
both lanes are live.
Never accept a contract address from a DM, a reply, or any other site.

## Lane 1 · FREE — one Common, Agent ID holders
- Call freeMint(uint256), selector 0x7c928fe9, argument = your Binance
  Agent ID number as a 32-byte word. Value: 0.
- The calling wallet must own that Agent ID in the Binance Agent registry
  0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F (checked on-chain).
- Max 1 per wallet, one claim per Agent ID. Always a Common (Calm Grey).
  Token IDs 1-667.

## Lane 2 · PAID — Rare and up, max 7 per wallet
- Call mint(uint256), selector 0xa0712d68, argument = quantity 1-7 as a
  32-byte word.
- Price: exactly 0.00144 BNB per boat = 1440000000000000 wei
  (roughly $1 — verify the live BNB price, and read currentPrice()
  on the contract before sending). Send exactly price x quantity.
- Pool: token IDs 668-1333 — Rare 333, Epic 200, Legendary 107,
  Mythic 26. Common is never sold.

## Step 0 · Market check (before any paid mint)
Check the collection on Element and report its floor price / top bid next
to the 0.00144 BNB mint price. Current status: NOT LISTED YET — there is
no floor or bid; "not listed" is the correct report. Never assume a floor.
Preview every call first; execute only if the preview is clean.

## Reads (view calls, no gas)
totalMinted() 0xa2309ff8 · freeMinted() 0xd10a1a2b · paidMinted() 0x2806b8fb
currentPrice() 0x9d1b464a · mintOpen() 0x24bbd049
freeMintedBy(address) 0xdd4d2233 · paidMintedBy(address) 0x80f231fb

## Honest notes
An artwork. No token, no roadmap, no promised returns. Both lanes open at
the same time and never block each other.
